name: agent-orch
description: Stage-first orchestration with runtime project identity, audited coordinator registration, shared workspace limits, recommended model routes, independent review and a local Auditor.

interface.shortDescription: Bind project identity and supervise reviewed, bounded workspaces.
interface.longDescription: Bind execution to the original project. Register necessary coordinator copies through audited reconciliation and share workspace limits across repositories. Recommend current model routes, preserve Worker progress during bounded upgrades, use quota-only review fallback, independently review and accept exact changes, then commit and safely retire worktrees. Preserve unrelated edits, model routes and historical evidence; inspect activity in the local Auditor. Hooks do not wake idle chats.
defaultPrompt: Recommend current stage models, let me use, edit or customize the matrix, and initialize Git policies while preserving existing changes.
Implement and independently review this task, then finalize its exact local commit and safely retire its worktree while preserving unrelated edits.
Integrate accepted parallel task results, independently review and accept the combined patch, then commit and clean up.
